nodes.description: This is a non-compositional metrics and planning stage for AI data center demand definition. It records rack density, total capacity, redundancy targets, PUE, and WUE as metrics rather than products, so it intentionally has zero L4 application-role children and no canonical composition.

AI data center stage for choosing and coordinating external and local energy supply portfolios, firm capacity, renewable attributes, generation options, and resilience targets before grid access and backup design.

For an AI data center, the Utility Grid Supply Strategy decision secures utility-delivered service capacity, firm grid volume, tariff exposure, delivery profile, curtailment rights, ramp limits, and utility service obligations. This role covers utility-provided energy service at the point of delivery and excludes onsite generation and procurement instruments such as PPAs, green tariffs, and certificates. It composes the canonical Bulk Grid Power Supply Service by selecting contracted service capacity, delivery terms, and resilience contribution around that reusable capability; canonical technology, company mapping, and evidence ownership remain with that target.

For an AI data center, the Renewable Energy Procurement decision specifies PPA structures, green tariffs, certificates, hourly or annual matching, contract tenor, shaped volume, and residual supply. This role covers contractual environmental and energy procurement instruments and excludes physical generation and microgrid control. It composes the canonical Renewable Power Procurement Service by selecting contract form, matching standard, volume profile, and residual-supply treatment around that reusable capability; canonical technology, company mapping, and evidence ownership remain with that target.

For an AI data center, the Distributed Energy Deployment decision configures onsite/local generation assets, capacity, siting, resource or fuel envelope, grid-parallel operation, and resilience contribution. This role covers physical distributed resources other than a dedicated gas turbine system and excludes the gas-turbine-specific route and microgrid orchestration. It composes the canonical Distributed Energy Generation System by selecting asset scale, operating envelope, site interface, and resilience duty around that reusable capability; canonical technology, company mapping, and evidence ownership remain with that target.

For an AI data center, the Gas Turbine Generation decision sets turbine equipment configuration, fuel firmness, dispatch schedule, capacity, duty cycle, emissions limits, ramping, heat recovery, and maintenance interval. This role covers gas turbine plant equipment and operation for an explicitly turbine-based supply route and excludes generic distributed resources. It composes the canonical Gas Turbine Generation System by selecting turbine duty, fuel assurance, dispatch constraints, and resilience contribution around that reusable capability; canonical technology, company mapping, and evidence ownership remain with that target.

For an AI data center, the Nuclear Power Supply decision sets nuclear-backed PPA terms, co-location arrangements, dedicated supply availability, firm-energy profile, delivery path, settlement terms, and fit with variable compute load. This role covers a nuclear-backed PPA, nuclear co-location, or another dedicated nuclear supply arrangement and excludes generic grid supply. It composes the canonical Nuclear Power Supply Service by selecting supply structure, delivery path, firmness, and settlement terms around that reusable capability; canonical technology, company mapping, and evidence ownership remain with that target.

For an AI data center, the Microgrid Architecture decision establishes microgrid orchestration, islanding boundaries, control logic, critical-load priority, synchronization, restoration logic, and grid-connected operating modes. This role covers control and operating modes across available resources and excludes ownership of generation assets. It composes the canonical Microgrid Generation System by selecting islanding policy, control hierarchy, restoration sequence, and resilience duty around that reusable capability; canonical technology, company mapping, and evidence ownership remain with that target.
